title: MobileNetV2: Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks

novelty_points.claim: 提出MobileNetV2，将倒残差结构与线性瓶颈结合，在移动端模型中以较低计算开销保留特征表达能力。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes MobileNetV2, combining inverted residuals and linear bottlenecks to retain representational power in mobile neural networks.
technical_features: 在较窄的瓶颈层之间建立快捷连接。
中间扩展层使用轻量级逐通道卷积处理特征。
移除窄层中的非线性激活以保持表达能力。
technical_features_en: Places shortcut connections between thin bottleneck layers.
Uses lightweight depthwise convolutions in the intermediate expansion layer.
Removes nonlinearities in narrow layers to maintain representational power.
